body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2007') -- <Visual News> “Contents, Technology and everything in between” .This is the theme of this year’s CES, which is being held in Las Vegas, USA. Aligned with this theme and introduced the world’s first dual format DVD player “Super multi blue” and Full HD displays.

Last year was said to be the year of introduction of Full HD displays and its contents to the market. This year, however, is the year that those technologies will rise above the horizon and begin to penetrate the market, most experts predict. LG electronics followed this trend and focused their CES displays on Full HD displays and its contents.

First, LG introduced newly designed 50/60/71 PDP TVs and 52-inch LCD TV in their Full HD TV lineups. They also blanketed HD TV section with 37/42/47/52/55/102 inch LCD TVs and 50/60/71/102 inch PDP TVs.

In addition, the world’s first dual format DVD player, “Super Multi Blue” was introduced during the CES on Jan. 7 of 2007. The player, which plays both Blue-Ray DVD format and HD-DVD format shocked many participants, analysts and reporters at the scene. The product will serve the consumers who could not decide which next generation format DVD player to purchase. LG expects this technological breakthrough to end the confusion and inconvenience of competing high-definition disc formats for both content producers and consumers. Super Multi Blue is planned to be available in the US early February of this year at the price of 1,199 USD.
As for the contents, LG electronics partnered with Warner Brothers to introduce their new Full HD movies and games on LG’s new Full HD models.
